pullRequest.title: fix(ui): restore pointer cursor on alert dialog buttons
pullRequest.body:
## Summary

Restore the expected pointer cursor for delete confirmation modal actions so alert dialog buttons consistently present as clickable controls.

## Changes

- Added `cursor-pointer` to the shared `AlertDialogAction` and `AlertDialogCancel` components in `ui/components/ui/alertDialog.tsx`
- Fixed the issue centrally so existing delete confirmation dialogs inherit the correct cursor behavior without per-modal overrides
